strings.Salle 22 - Salle active - 1 Gardien à pi: Room 22 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Stalker, 1 Guardian Skywatcher, 1 Guardian Turret: Defeat the Guardian Skywatcher and Guardian Stalker with Ancient Arrows, then climb to the Guardian Turret if necessary.

strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 3 Bokoblins : U: Room 1 - Combat room - 3 Bokoblins: Use the tree as cover, then detonate a bomb near the fire. Immediately collect the weapons and food.
strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 4 Stalkoblins :: Room 1 - Combat room - 4 Stalkoblins: Mostly use bombs, destroy the skulls, and save all wooden weapons for later.
strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 5 Bokoblins : L: Room 1 - Combat room - 5 Bokoblins: Let bombs float beneath the platforms to save weapon durability, then open the chest on the right.
strings.Salle 10 - Salle active - 1 Lézalfos ble: Room 10 - Combat room - 1 Blue Lizalfos, 2 Black Lizalfos: Create a Cryonis pillar to shoot in slow motion, then focus all your attacks on one target at a time.
strings.Salle 10 - Salle active - 3 Moblins noir: Room 10 - Combat room - 3 Black Moblins, 1 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Use Stasis and electricity. Keep the Moblins from falling into the lava so you can collect their weapons.
strings.Salle 11 - Salle active - 1 Magrok : Ref: Room 11 - Combat room - 1 Igneo Talus: Cool its body with ice, use the updrafts, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Salle 11 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 11 - Rest room - None: Catch the two fairies, open the three chests, and cook all the useful food.
strings.Salle 12 - Salle active - 1 Hinox bleu :: Room 12 - Combat room - 1 Blue Hinox: Aim at its eye, use Stasis+, and strike it with a two-handed weapon whenever it falls.
strings.Salle 12 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 12 - Rest room - None: Catch the three fairies, open the chests, and cook several cold-resistant meals for the next section.
strings.Salle 13 - Salle active - 2 Lithoroks ju: Room 13 - Combat room - 2 Frost Pebblits, 1 Ice Chuchu, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin: Use fire against frozen enemies and make use of the final cooking pot.
strings.Salle 13 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 13 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 40.
strings.Salle 15 - Salle active - 1 Moblin noir,: Room 15 - Combat room - 1 Black Moblin, 1 Ice Wizzrobe, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Silver Bokoblin: Defeat the Wizzrobe with fire before it summons reinforcements, then isolate the larger enemies.
strings.Salle 16 - Salle active - 1 Cryorok : Fa: Room 16 - Combat room - 1 Frost Talus: Melt its ice, use the Stone Smasher from the rest room, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Salle 16 - Salle active - 1 Nano Gardien: Room 16 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Scout IV: Save a durable weapon, use each perfect dodge, and ride the updrafts from the rotating laser.
strings.Salle 17 - Salle active - 1 Lynel bleu :: Room 17 - Combat room - 1 Blue-Maned Lynel: Snow makes movement difficult: use an Ancient Arrow to conserve health and equipment.
strings.Salle 17 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 17 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 50.
strings.Salle 18 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 18 - Rest room - None: Catch the four fairies, cook a meal that fully restores health, and open the three chests containing Royal weapons.
strings.Salle 19 - Salle active - 6 Gardiens dét: Room 19 - Combat room - 6 Decayed Guardians: Use the trees to block incoming shots, attack each Guardian from behind, and save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Salle 2 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu de feu: Room 2 - Combat room - 1 Fire Chuchu, 4 Bokoblins: Defeat the Chuchu from the tall tree, then use bombs to dislodge the archers one at a time.
strings.Salle 2 - Salle active - 2 Bokoblins, 1: Room 2 - Combat room - 2 Bokoblins, 1 Blue Bokoblin, 1 Fire Wizzrobe, 2 Meteo Wizzrobes: Defeat the Wizzrobes with arrows before they change the weather, then finish off the Bokoblins.
strings.Salle 20 - Salle active - 1 Gardien à pi: Room 20 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Stalker: Cut off its legs, aim at its eye, and fight it normally to save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Salle 21 - Salle active - 1 Gardien vola: Room 21 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Skywatcher: Climb the towers to gain height, destroy its propellers, or use an Ancient Arrow.
strings.Salle 23 - Salle active - 8 Bokoblins mo: Room 23 - Combat room - 8 mounted Bokoblins, 1 White-Maned Lynel, 1 Guardian Turret: Immediately defeat the Lynel with an Ancient Arrow, defeat the Guardian Turret, then finish off the mounted enemies.
strings.Salle 24 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 24 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk: the Master Sword now permanently retains its base attack power of 60.
strings.Salle 3 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu, 8 Chu: Room 3 - Combat room - 1 Chuchu, 8 Fire Chuchus: Blast the Chuchus from a distance and use the updrafts before the grass stops burning.
strings.Salle 3 - Salle active - 2 Chuchus élect: Room 3 - Combat room - 2 Electric Chuchus, 5 Stalmoblins: Blast the Chuchus from a distance, then use bombs to disarm and finish off the Stalmoblins.
strings.Salle 4 - Salle active - 1 Gardien détér: Room 4 - Combat room - 1 Decayed Guardian: Keep an obstacle between the laser and Link, aim at its eye, then attack while the laser is interrupted.
strings.Salle 4 - Salle active - 7 Stalkoblins m: Room 4 - Combat room - 7 Stalkoblins mounted: Steal a Stalhorse, jump to shoot in slow motion, and aim at the mounted enemies' heads.
strings.Salle 5 - Salle active - 1 Stalhinox : D: Room 5 - Combat room - 1 Stalnox: Knock out its eye, destroy it before dawn, and collect the three elemental weapons attached to its body.
strings.Salle 5 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Captu: Room 5 - Rest room - None: Catch the fairy, open the three chests, and cook before entering the dark section.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle active - 1 Lithorok : Dé: Room 6 - Combat room - 1 Stone Talus: Destroy its arms with bombs, climb onto it when it falls, and strike the ore deposit with a two-handed weapon.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle active - 5 Chauves-souri: Room 6 - Combat room - 5 Fire Keese, 1 Electric Chuchu: In the dark, look for glowing enemies. Defeat the Keese from a distance, then the Chuchu.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Captu: Room 6 - Rest room - None: Catch the two fairies and save the three Ancient Arrows for the final rooms.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu de feu: Room 7 - Combat room - 1 Fire Chuchu, 1 Rock Octorok, 2 Igneo Pebblits: Keep your distance: bombs are enough to clear this entire volcanic room.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle active - 2 Lézalfos crac: Room 7 - Combat room - 2 Fire-Breath Lizalfos, 2 Blue Lizalfos: Use ice against the fire-breathing enemies, and fight one target at a time in the lit area.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Appro: Room 7 - Rest room - None: Approach while crouching to catch the fairy, break the crates, and cook the ingredients before leaving.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 1 Sorcier météo: Room 8 - Combat room - 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin: Defeat the Wizzrobe first to prevent reinforcements, then use its fire weapon as a light source.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 1 gros Chuchu é: Room 8 - Combat room - 1 large Electric Chuchu, 2 Lizalfos, 2 Blue Lizalfos: Defeat the Chuchu from the rock, grab the spear, and isolate the Lizalfos with Stasis.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 3 Lézalfos crac: Room 8 - Combat room - 3 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Use the updrafts to aim at their heads, then defeat them with the ice weapon.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 1 Gardien détér: Room 9 - Combat room - 1 Decayed Guardian: Find its eye in the dark, take cover behind the scenery, and reflect or interrupt its laser.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 1 Sorcier météo: Room 9 - Combat room - 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 1 Black Moblin, 2 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Defeat the Wizzrobe first and keep its Meteor Rod for the cold section.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 2 Octos d'eau,: Room 9 - Combat room - 2 Water Octoroks, 1 Electric Wizzrobe: Defeat the Octorok behind the starting point, lift the chest with Cryonis, then keep the Wizzrobe on the ground.
strings.Parle à Jitah au domaine zora et photogr: Speak to Jiahto at Zora's Domain and photograph the repaired monument.
strings.Depuis le socle, tire une flèche à trave: From the pedestal, shoot an arrow through the heart when the light illuminates it to reveal Bareeda Naag Shrine.
strings.Plane vers la congère en forme d'oiseau: Glide toward the bird-shaped snowdrift and break the cracked wall to enter Mozo Shenno Shrine.
strings.Survis à la dernière manche avec une pro: Survive the final round with sufficient flame protection to reveal Joloo Nah Shrine.
strings.Tire ensuite sur une corne, ramasse l'éc: Then shoot a horn, collect the horn shard, and offer it at the Spring of Wisdom to open Jitan Sa'mi Shrine.
strings.Utilise une feuille Korogu pour souffler: Use a Korok Leaf to blow air through the stone pillars in the order from the song to reveal Voo Lota Shrine.
strings.Atteins l'extrémité de la chaîne de stat: Reach the end of the chain of statues and activate Kema Zoos Shrine.
strings.Atteins la salle centrale et active le s: Reach the central room and activate Dila Maag Shrine.
strings.Atteins le sommet dans les conditions de: Reach the top in the conditions required to reveal Gorae Torr Shrine.
strings.Bats le record de 1 min 30 s pour recevo: Beat the record of 1 min 30 s to receive the orb, then place it in the base of Raqa Zunzo Shrine.
strings.Conduis le cerf sur le socle près de Asa: Drive the deer on the base near Kass to reveal Mezza Lo Shrine.
strings.Descends dans la salle intérieure et act: Go down into the inner room and activate Tu Ka'loh Shrine.
strings.Dépose la griffe dans l'eau devant la st: Place the claw in the water in front of the statue to open access to Tutsuwa Nima Shrine.
strings.Place chaque orbe dans le socle portant: Place each orb in the base bearing the corresponding symbol to reveal Korsh O'hu Shrine.
